description: Return sample bequest wording for a will or trust that gives a percentage or dollar amount to causes or named charities, for the person or their attorney to adapt. Use for quick questions like "how do I word a gift to charity in my will?"

causes.description: Causes that receive the charitable gift, with each one's share. Use list_causes for the built-in causes, or describe your own.

cause.description: A cause slug or name from list_causes (e.g. "cancer", "animal-welfare", "hometown", "faith"), or a short name for a cause of the person's own.

charity.description: A specific organization to receive this cause's share (required for "faith"; optional otherwise).

city_state.description: City and state of the organization.

community.description: For the "hometown" cause: the city, town or county to benefit.

custom_purpose.description: For a cause not in list_causes: what the money should be used for, e.g. "research into Alzheimer's disease".

percent.description: This cause's share of the charitable gift. Shares are scaled to total 100%.

fund.description: Only for giving_method named_fund: a foundation-style named fund that keeps giving.

advisors.description: Up to three people who will recommend grants.

lifespan.description: Spend everything within about 10 or 25 years, or keep it permanent (about 5% a year).

mission.description: The fund's mission in the person's own words.

name.description: Fund name, e.g. "The Ellis Family Fund".

use_research.description: Ask that grants follow MyLastWill.org's research (default true).

giving_method.description: research_guided: each cause's share goes to Systemic Altruism Foundation's (EIN 87-2067921) Cause Fund for that cause, which grants it to effective charities working on it, guided by MyLastWill.org research (default). named_charities: give to the specific charities listed under each cause. named_fund: create a named legacy fund (see fund).

percent.description: Percentage of the residuary estate. Use this or amount.

name: get_bequest_language
title: Get charitable bequest wording
